summary: Iteration 4 (major update) tested backend + Expo web UI (375x667). Backend: 17 new tests (test_iter4_features.py) + 55 regression tests = 72/72 pass AFTER fixing a CRITICAL regression: POST /api/vehicles had lost its @api.post decorator (404, drivers could not add vehicles). Verified: OSRM route estimate (326 km BLR-Chennai, source osrm), cost_breakdown math, price cap 400, return trip with return_of, recent searches upsert/max10/clear, missing place submit->admin approve->searchable, fuel prices admin/public, full hire flow (phone gate, photo gate, under_review, admin approve, public photo 404->200, search estimate + has_photo, booking pending, masked phone 98••••••78, 409 duplicate, accept by driver only, phones unmasked, start/complete, HIR review, profile About Me), chat (conversations kind/unread, delivered->read ticks, system messages for hire_request/confirmed/cancelled and carpool booking_confirmed/cancelled, outsider 404). Frontend: home (logo, 4 header icons, 3 service cards, recent search appears + Clear works), /more groups, search calendar (past days disabled), search-hire-link, offer calculator (road distance 326 km OSM, recommended ₹717, use-recommended, return switch), hire form->results->/user/[id] About Me->send request->/hire/[id] masked, pro driver Bookings 'Driver hire' chip->accept->unmasked->chat with system msgs + Delivered tick, /messages list with unread badge, LocationField 'can't find' -> /add-place submit, admin pro/places/settings tabs. Fixed missing i18n keys admin.pro/admin.places (tabs showed raw keys). No deprecated expo packages found.

critical.issue: Route decorator missing (add_vehicle defined without @api.post) -> 404; drivers could not add vehicles. FIXED by tester in server.py.

minor.issue: Price cap only enforced when fuel_price is sent; omitting fuel_price lets a driver publish ₹5000/seat (verified 200). Enforce cap server-side using admin fuel price + vehicle mileage, or require calculator inputs.
No default fuel prices seeded -> prices {} so the Offer calculator mileage/fuel fields start empty (demo vehicle also has no mileage). Seed 'default' petrol/diesel/cng/electric.
If files record is missing, f is None -> 500 instead of 404 (server.py ~1458).
Whitespace-only text passes min_length then strip() stores empty message.
Allowed directly from 'confirmed' (skips start); UI shows Start and Complete together when confirmed. Confirm intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Tabs 'pro' and 'places' displayed raw keys 'admin.pro'/'admin.places' (missing en.json keys). FIXED by tester.
After successful submit router.back() with no history raises 'The action GO_BACK was not handled' (direct URL/refresh). Use router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/').
Customer contact card is labelled 'Passengers' (t('search.passengers')) for hire bookings; should be 'Customer'.
Approved profiles still show Approve/Reject buttons.

issues: Typing price 9999 (cap ₹1076) shows no inline warning before publishing; only the backend rejects it
Return date calendar defaults to 'Any date', which makes no sense for a return trip
Toast after hire accept says generic 'Saved'
testIDs are generated with a double dash (e.g. more--info-s-about); cosmetic

Enforce the price cap even when fuel_price is omitted
Seed default fuel prices (state 'default') so the calculator prefills
Guard public photo against a missing file record (404 not 500)
add-place: fall back when router cannot go back
hire/[id]: label the customer as 'Customer' for the driver; consider hiding Complete until the trip is started
Admin pro 'Approved' list: hide Approve, show Suspend/Reject only
Split server.py (1806 lines) into routers (hire, chat, places, trips)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1806 lines (>700); split into modules
hire_action calls notify() (which already writes the system message for SYS_EVENTS) and then sys_message() again; harmless due to upsert but redundant
sys_message upserts by (booking_id, sys_type): a repeated event of the same type is only recorded once

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; minor UI issues)
